notes: Packet mismatch: the domain notes describe a new PerformCastSpell detour at 0x00775703 (6 stolen bytes, exit 0x0077574C, eax excluded from restore, handler in exports.def), but the packet file has no detour. Line 5 is `hooks = []`, and a grep of the whole gui_input_src directory finds no PerformCastSpell, 775703, or 774C. So the detour cannot be audited from this packet. Either it lives in a file outside wp2-002 (which would need its own packet), or the notes are stale. Nothing here verifies the stolen bytes, RET cleanup, EBP frame, or the exports.def definition. The sibling kotor2-steam-aspyr.hooks.toml also has `hooks = []` at line 5, so Steam/GOG parity holds for this file. Scanner candidates S-6cce48e112, S-bc928cc472 and S-dabd1d06bf are false positives: the TOML is valid, and the 'non-block line' hits are the normal [metadata] keys. Dismissed, not confirmed. Not verified: the target_versions hash on line 3 has no source in the packet, so it cannot be checked against the vanilla exe. Also, `hooks = []` sits under [metadata] (line 2), not at top level. The Steam file uses the same layout, which suggests a repo convention, but I did not read the manifest loader to confirm it. Checker facts (build_check PASS, common_contract_test PASS) are consistent with the file. check_hook_spans reads the live patch_config.toml, so its result is provisional as stated.
